attributes.title: 2027 MI-ACP and SHM-MI Annual Scientific Meeting
attributes.series: MI-ACP and SHM-MI Annual Scientific Meeting
attributes.venue: Radisson Plaza Hotel at Kalamazoo Center
attributes.summary:
Michigan's ACP chapter and the state chapter of the Society of Hospital Medicine hold a joint Annual Scientific Meeting from Thursday, October 7, to Sunday, October 10, 2027. It takes place at the Radisson Plaza Hotel at Kalamazoo Center in downtown Kalamazoo. Because both groups plan it together, the program should suit office-based internists and hospitalists.

When we checked, the chapter had listed only the dates and venue. Program, credits, fees and hotel booking were not yet posted. The two chapters also hold a separate Resident and Medical Student Day on May 7, 2027, in Troy.
